display_name: 固定纯 CE 父基线上的40轮多解耦：C0至C3三种子clean验证
description: 三份固定E200纯CE父权重各自分叉C0/C1/C2/C3；40轮8880次身份更新；保护项、真实L/T动作和跨TX核验的R单向裕量修复；固定C3为84%三种子均值主终点。
authorization: 2026-10-11用户明确要求严格实现最新设计并发布三种子实验；对应纯CE父权重，每方案40epoch，每卡4进程，训练后自动只测clean；12行对应已接受C0-C3完整设计。

notes: Latest explicit scope: implement and publish 12 rows, three seeds per C0/C1/C2/C3, E40, maximum four processes per GPU, automatic clean only.
Current code base9a7e184c37f5936e5a4cafc12175183a8a0e7b2a is not the pending execution release commit; runtime writes actual release_commit.txt.
Parent checkpoints native r02 are byte-preserved r01 E200 weights; r02 only recovered diagnostics; full origin d4723b1aa227fce6368fd25680bb74b1190557d7.
Strict parent load occurs before source cache/actions/R initialization. Parent optimizer/scaler/RNG are not resumed.
No U sampling, pseudo-labels, EMA teacher, satellite augmentation, GRL, orthogonality, mutual information, MixStyle or Fishr in this matrix.
R state preprocessing fitted on four TX per fold; held-out two TX supply relation error. Prediction uses no identity embedding/RX ID/labels/student loss.
Finite fixed coefficients keep=.1,augCE=.25,drop=.1,R=.1; ramp first444updates; thresholds .5 logit; no ratio-derived adaptive weights.
Relation sampler is common across all arms. Every8 updates reserve32 slots for2TXx2RXx8 distinct IDs; absent relationships are counted, never fabricated.
L/T frozen after two full sourceL traversals each; every4 identity updates at most32 samples; action order L,L,T,T; no joint action.

New T delay +/-0.25sample is an explicitly fixed mild timing perturbation: zero-padding256 eachside/768FFT/central crop; finite-window zero-extension may ring, not calibrated channel or satellite simulation.
Identity gradient audit every888updates reports weighted/unweighted absolute norms and ratios only if CE norm>1e-12; no automatic parameter tuning.
Record parent cost, shared preparation once per seed, each40epoch run and test separately; measured shared-GPU wall and peak memory, no inferred speedup.
No healthy existing experiment is stopped or modified. Technical failures preserve outputs and receive no automatic rerun.
84% target remains unverified until all three C3 independent clean scores exist; no best-arm replacement or feedback into training.
首次发布r01在CPU父checkpoint反序列化预检失败，尚未创建run或训练进程；修复native模块导入顺序后改用不可覆盖的release r02，实验run/矩阵/数据/预算不变。

test_completion_plan.trigger: Each row E40 final freeze immediately enters clean prediction+CPU scoring; no full-matrix training barrier
test_completion_plan.parent_reference: Reuse same-seed P0 existing clean predictions with identical physical IDs; never retrain or select by scores
test_completion_plan.default_six_practical_override: Current explicit user instruction: automatic clean only; no satellite views

physical_actions.objective: maximize fixed-parent true-IQ logit-margin drop; fixed classifier scale 30

temporal.phase_process: three smooth sine modes; clipped Gaussian coefficients

fractional_delay.operator: zero-pad 256 each side, FFT phase shift, crop original central 256
fractional_delay.zero_delay: exact value identity with differentiable delay path
fractional_delay.boundary_assumption: IQ outside observed 256-sample window is zero; sinc interpolation may ring near truncated edges
fractional_delay.scope: new fixed mild timing perturbation, not satellite/channel simulation or calibrated source error

physical_actions.random: explicit private CPU generators; no global RNG consumption
